review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the related definitions in PDCode/Basic.lean (crossingSlotEquiv, oppositeCrossingSlot, slotSmoothing). The file defines PDCode.rotateCrossing and OrientedPDCode.rotateCrossing, which re-read one crossing of a PD-code from its next slot. This is a domain-specific operation on the project's own PDCode structure. It is built from Mathlib's permCongr, prodCongrRight and finRotate. I know of no Mathlib concept for it, so it does not compete with one. The private helper lemmas about slotSmoothing and oppositeCrossingSlot are statements about the project's own definitions, not duplicate concepts. I found nothing that justifies a finding under this rubric.
